summary: The artifact is valid TypeScript and uses Playwright APIs correctly. Await is properly used on asynchronous assertions. The selectors use data-test attributes which are generally robust. However, the test lacks testCaseId in the test title for traceability. The assertions, while correct, only check visibility and do not verify product details or navigation. The test is maintainable and clear with no async or compilation issues.

issues.description: The test title does not preserve the associated testCaseId 'TC-001', reducing traceability between requirements and tests.
issues.recommendation: Include the testCaseId in the test title to improve traceability.

issues.description: Assertions only check visibility of product cards, without validating content such as product images, names, or prices.
issues.recommendation: Add assertions to verify product details for stronger test coverage.

recommendations: Incorporate testCaseId identifiers in test titles (e.g., 'TC-001: Display of Product Cards on Home Page').
Expand assertions beyond visibility to verify product details where evidence and selectors are available.
Consider adding navigation tests if evidence becomes available for product detail pages in future.
